Metadata.Name: New Employee Access Provisioning
Metadata.Description: Triggered on day-one of employment to provision standard role-based access for a new joiner.

Activity.Name: Notify IT Helpdesk
Activity.Description: Alert IT helpdesk that a new joiner requires equipment and base system accounts.

Activity.Name: HR Confirms Role Assignment
Activity.Description: HR confirms the job role so the correct access profile can be applied.

Activity.Name: Provision Role-Based Access
Activity.Description: Assign the standard access entitlements mapped to the confirmed job role.
